governance.note: Re-grounds the NEISO combined-cycle clearing LEVEL exposed when a8b0e55 ('PJM/NYISO/NEISO CC: nameplate capacity + one measured summer derate') removed the false ~75%-of-nameplate CC wall. a8b0e55 is KEPT ON (cc_nameplate_summer_derate, default-on for NEISO) — the wall is NOT restored (CLAUDE.md #1/#11). Inherits every measured lever of neiso-29/neiso-30 UNCHANGED (biomass measured must-run, OTHER residual vintage-carry _reconciled_mustrun_class, like-for-like EIA-930 total, measured AGT daily gas overlay, historic outage overlay) and adds ONE measured-input refinement, ISO-gated to NEISO. RANK-1 GAS BASIS CHECKED FIRST AND CLEARED: NEISO gas is the measured Algonquin/EIA-MA-citygate hub index (gas_basis_by_iso_month.csv), repriced in 12/12 months at the measured hub spot with winter blowouts to $30.13/$26.69/$35.56/MMBtu (daily AGT overlay) — delivered gas is NOT too cheap, it is the authoritative measurement, so the offer level (not the basis) is the lever (CLAUDE.md #11 guardrail satisfied). RANK-2 CC OFFER FLOOR (the applied lever): the per-plant CAMPD heat-rate curve for the 61-unit NEISO CC fleet (2023-2025 hourly grossLoad/heatInput) shows min-stable-load (40-55% of nameplate, the committed tranche) runs at 1.30x the gen-weighted fleet-average heat rate while full load (>0.90) runs at 0.93x — min-load is ~40% LESS efficient than full load. The legacy offer priced the CC committed (min-load) tranche at 0.92x base HR, i.e. BELOW the full-load offer (econ_high 1.27x), the inverse of the measured shape; that artificially-cheap min-load block was masked by the net-summer CC wall and, once the wall was removed, collapsed the NEISO clearing level into 13-20% under-prediction. The committed multiplier is re-anchored 0.92 -> 1.27 (= econ_high) FOR NEISO ONLY, so the min-load $/MWh is at-or-above full-load SRMC (the ISO-NE Market Rule 1 incremental-energy shape, rank-2 condition). 1.27 is the conservative floor of the measured band (the CAMPD curve supports up to ~1.30); it is anchored to the measured heat-rate SHAPE, NOT to the price residual (CLAUDE.md #11/#12). econ_low/econ_high/peak are UNCHANGED (econ_high 1.27 already sits above the measured 0.93x full-load HR, so raising it would be fitting). RESULT: C3a system mean LMP recovers from neiso-30's -20.0/-18.7/-13.3% (vs actual DA) to -7.9/-6.3/-1.8% (vs RT: -5.0/-1.6/+1.2%), ~12pp across all three years, landing in the calibrated band and matching the pre-wall ccsteam keeper (-4.7/-2.3/+4.9%) but now WITHOUT the wall, via a measured mechanism. Energy balance stays clean (model gen - EIA-930 net gen = +0.13/+0.14/+0.17 TWh). Gas volume stays bounded and improves toward measured (model gas 54.22/58.81/61.59 vs EIA-930 55.47/59.64/60.09 = -2.3/-1.4/+2.5%); CC backs down slightly from neiso-30's over-stuffing as the more-expensive min-load block recovers headroom. Oil winter tail now bites (2025 oil 1.60 vs 1.24 actual, was ~0.06 in neiso-30) as the higher CC min-load offer trips more dual-fuel gas->oil switching on cold days. RECOMMENDATION: promote to NEISO keeper over neiso-29 (whose price fit was wall-masked; CLAUDE.md #1 keeper = most structurally faithful). The remaining residual — 2023 -7.9% DA and the price tail (0h > $300 vs 15/8/20h actual) — is the winter reserve-scarcity item (TMSR/TMNSR/TMOR single-fuel AGT-spot bidding and in-LP reserve co-optimization), a SEPARATE structural task (rank 3), NOT a defect of this lever; do not force it into this run. No adder/haircut/pin/rescale to any residual.
governance.validation_note: Measured anchor derivation reproducible from data/raw/campd-unit-level/{CT,MA,ME,NH,RI,VT}_{2023,2024,2025}.parquet, unitType=='Combined cycle', hourly heatInput/grossLoad: gen-weighted avg HR 8.05 mmBtu/MWh; load-fraction-binned ratios committed band(40-55%)=1.30x, full-load(>0.90)=0.93x, deep part-load(5-30%)=1.41x. The committed multiplier 1.27 = econ_high, the minimum satisfying 'min-load $/MWh >= full-load SRMC'. ERCOT/PJM/CAISO/MISO/SPP byte-identical: the lever is `committed: 1.27 if iso == 'NEISO' else 0.92` (run_calibration.py CC_REGULAR offer_curve_by_group); ERCOT keeps 0.92. Gas basis check: 12/12 months measured-hub-repriced all years (run log 'hub-basis overlay (NEISO, daily): ... 12/12 months'). P2 commitment engaged (meta.passes = [P1, P2]).

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (separate structural item: winter reserve scarcity, rank 3)
exceptions.reason: NEISO scarcity spikes come from operating-reserve scarcity (TMSR/TMNSR/TMOR) and single-fuel Algonquin-spot bidding on cold days, neither represented in the energy-only LP (dual-fuel gas is still capped at delivered oil parity). This is the documented NEISO reserve-co-optimization follow-up (its own measured requirement series), out of scope for the CC offer-level fix; it is the main driver of the residual 2023 -7.9% (DA) under-prediction. Not a measured-input limitation and not closable by an offer adder without fitting.

exceptions.metric: C3a system mean LMP vs actual DA
exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (downstream of the price_tail / reserve-scarcity item)
exceptions.reason: The 2023 residual concentrates in the highest-weight winter months whose scarcity is set by the unrepresented reserve mechanism above; 2024/2025 are within band vs RT (-1.6/+1.2%). Recovered ~12pp from neiso-30 via the measured min-load re-anchor; the remainder is the rank-3 reserve item, not a further offer tune.

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (offer-floor trim in 2023; EIA-923-vs-EIA-930 OTHER categorization in 2025)
exceptions.reason: 2023: the measured min-load re-anchor (committed 0.92->1.27) backs CC down ~0.7 TWh, flipping the prior neiso-30 over-stuffing to a small under in the low-gas year; this is the intended structural direction (the wall-masked cheap min-load block recovering headroom) overshooting the band by a small margin, not a measured-input issue and well within the energy balance (+0.13 TWh). 2025: total model generation matches the measured grid total (energy balance +0.17 TWh), so the residual is the irreducible EIA-923-vs-EIA-930 OTHER (process gas / landfill / purchased steam) categorization difference in the partial 2025 vintage (EIA-930 attributes 4.40 TWh to 'other unspecified' vs measured forward-reproducible EIA-923 ~3.35 complete / 2.78 carried), served by gas-CC in the model. Closable only by reconciling the OTHER categorization, NOT by injecting the EIA-930 residual (fitting).

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (downstream of the price_tail / reserve-scarcity item)
exceptions.reason: Storage arbitrage throughput tracks the price spread. The re-anchor recovered the price LEVEL (C3a) and lifted storage cycling from -76% to -64%, but the residual under-cycling follows the still-missing winter scarcity TAIL (C3c, 0h > $300): without the reserve-scarcity spikes the peak-to-trough spread that drives pumped-storage discharge stays compressed. Closes when the rank-3 reserve co-optimization lands, not via a storage or offer tune.
